candidates.title: Draft & Verify: Lossless Large Language Model Acceleration via Self-Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Foundational self-speculative decoding approach that drafts by selectively skipping layers and verifies with the original model without extra draft-model memory.

candidates.title: QServe: W4A8KV4 Quantization and System Co-design for Efficient LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Quantization-and-system co-design for cloud LLM serving with W4A8KV4 execution, fused kernels, and strong throughput/cost results.

candidates.title: KVShare: An LLM Service System with Efficient and Effective Multi-Tenant KV Cache Reuse
candidates.reason: Focused multi-tenant serving system for cross-request KV-cache reuse, targeting TTFT and shared-cache efficiency under long-context workloads.

candidates.title: Online Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Speculative-decoding system that continuously adapts draft models to live query distributions to improve acceptance rates under workload shift.
